localizedValues.name: S2 Beach Shelter
localizedValues.description:
The beach shelter is a Historic building which is 345 square feet (interior). The facility has a working indoor fireplace, a sink and counter, lights and 4 electrical plug ins. There are two picnic tables inside and two outside that can seat 8 people each. The shelter is located on the swim beach which is a very busy area during sunny spring and summer days. The reservation would include the two tables immediately in front of the shelter.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: Legacy Pavilion
localizedValues.description: The Legacy Pavilion on Lake Sylvia is a fully enclosed facility. Upon request staff can open the walls for a scenic view of the lake. The facility is available from 9:00am until dusk. Parking is shared with users throughout the park, carpooling is recommended. A Discover Pass is required. Parking near the pavilion is limited. Amenities of the pavilion include: 12 electrical outlets (7 outside and 5 inside), hot water sink on the outside, interior and exterior lights, and access to nearby restroom. This facility is not heated; however, the fireplace provides minimal heat. Must provide your own clean and dry firewood for the fireplace. No rubbish or treated woods may be burned. There may be closures to the fireplace depending on burn ban levels. Users are responsible for their own tables and chairs. To preserve a peaceful experience for other park guests, amplified music is not permitted. Public address systems may be used with prior approval from park staff. For further information please contact the park directly at 360-249-3621.
